title: Delegation Mandate
note: Standing authority a human grants an agent: which channels, for how long, at what rate. Issued once and referenced by many Communication Mandates. `principal_signature` is the human's OWN signature and the root of every credential issued under this mandate — without it no party has proved the human granted anything, and the notary's countersignature would be vouching for nothing. `allowed_channels` is the scope check producing APH_E005. `valid_until` matters more than it looks: expiry is the primary revocation mechanism in v0.1 because on-wire revocation transport is deferred to v0.2, which is why short windows are recommended.
book_ref: APH Spec: §6.1 DelegationMandate, §7.1.7.1 Why the delegation is embedded
